# Cubing Icons 3BLD favicon

Source: https://github.com/cubing/icons/blob/5f9b4bb2e78acd3fe4322fc0c0ddba54ea3c0636/src/svg/event/333bf.svg

MIT license; copyright Devin Corr-Robinett. Original SVG and license are retained here. The app favicon preserves all original path geometry and changes only foreground (#ededec) and background (#1a1a1b). PNG/ICO variants are rasterized from that SVG; no generated logo is used.

The deployed assets include `web/public/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`; both SVG favicon aliases also retain an attribution/license comment.

The versioned padded-v2 glyph is rendered at 72% of the original SVG path size (about 55% of canvas height), centered by its actual SVG path bounds; all four path definitions and colours remain unchanged.

Tab icon links use fresh `padded-v2` SVG/PNG filenames so prior browser favicon caches cannot reuse the unversioned images.
